plan: DUMMIE PLAN V1 — Cognitive Evolution Operating Layer

claims: Coverage must be measured as connected evidence, not file volume.
Triplet integrity, layer-language linkage, and capability-test linkage are enough to gate progression at this stage.
Inherited debt must be isolated to avoid false regression signals.
objections: Filename heuristics can over- or under-link specs to capabilities.
Layer coverage can appear complete while confidence remains uneven.
Legacy missing-spec references can be misread as new gate failures.
decisions: Use tracked-file scan and world-model capability inventory as coverage basis.
Classify known legacy guide debt as inherited warning.
Allow progression with warnings when thresholds pass and blockers are empty.
Require P9 to consume matrix constraints before note creation.
risks: Coverage matrix freshness drift if specs/tests evolve without regeneration.
Cross-layer test density remains uneven beyond L2.
Some non-numeric spec families require manual interpretation in later phases.

gate_decision.reason: Coverage thresholds pass with high triplet integrity; inherited debt and uneven confidence remain warning-level.

snowball_assessment.reason: P8 introduces measurable readiness gates and debt isolation before note and context phases.

warnings: Known legacy spec debt remains in doc/guides/mcp_server_usage.md.
Triplet incompleteness exists in a small subset of legacy spec families.
Coverage confidence remains uneven across non-L2 layers.
